Duas Syeda Fatima(sa) Duas Salat of Syeda Resources Arabic Transliteration Translation Protection against Opression duas page FREEDOM FROM CAPTIVITY To be out of prison or be free from captivity recite the following du-a'a Fourth: The du`a for being released from prison: In his book Muhaj al-Da`awat, Sayyid ibn Tawus has written, "It has been related that a person was imprisoned in Shaam (Syria) for a long time. He dreamt about Hazrat Fatimah (`a) , who taught him this du`a and advised him to recite it. When he did so, he was released and went home. segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِحَقِّ الْعَرْشِ وَ مَنْ عَلاَهُ وَ بِحَقِّ الْوَحْيِ وَ مَنْ أَوْحَاهُ
segments.transliteration: Allahumma Bi Haqqil Arshi Wa Man 'Alaahu Wa Bi Haqqil Wahee Wa Man Awhaahu
segments.translation: O' Allah! for the sake of the Throne and the One Who is above it, and for the sake of Revelation and the One Who revealed it,

segments.arabic: وَ بِحَقِّ النَّبِيِّ وَ مَنْ نَبَّأَهُ وَ بِحَقِّ الْبَيْتِ وَ مَنْ بَنَاهُ
segments.transliteration: Wa Bi Haqqinnabee'ee Wa Mannabbaahu Wa Bi Haqqil Bayti Wa Man Banaahu.
segments.translation: and for the sake of the Prophet and the One Who appointed him, and for the sake of the House and the One Who constructed it.

segments.arabic: يَا سَامِعَ كُلِّ صَوْتٍ يَا جَامِعَ كُلِّ فَوْتٍ يَا بَارِئَ النُّفُوسِ بَعْدَ الْمَوْتِ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ
segments.transliteration: Ya Saamia' Kulli Sawt. Yaa Jaamia' Kulli Fawt. Yaa Baarian Nufuusi Badal Mawt. Salli 'Ala Muhammad Wa Ahle Bayte-Hee
segments.translation: O' Hearer of every sound! O' Collector of all that will pass. O' Creator of the souls after (their) death. Send Your blessings on Muhammad and his family

segments.arabic: وَ آتِنَا وَ جَمِيعَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ فِي مَشَارِقِ الْأَرْضِ وَ مَغَارِبِهَا فَرَجاً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ عَاجِلاً بِشَهَادَةِ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ
segments.transliteration: Wa Aatinaa Wa Jameefal Mo'meneen Wal Mo'menaat Fee Mashaariqal Ardhee Wa Maghaaribihaa Farajan Min 'Indika 'Aajilan Bi Shahaadati An Laa Ilaha Illa Allaah
segments.translation: and grant us and (grant all) the believing men and believing women in the east of the Earth and the west of if (the Earth) deliverance from Yourself, speedily (in this world), with the bearing witness that there is no god except Allah

segments.arabic: وَ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُكَ وَ رَسُولُكَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ عَلَى ذُرِّيَّتِهِ الطَّيِّبِينَ الطَّاهِرِينَ وَ سَلَّمَ تَسْلِيماً كَثِيراً
segments.transliteration: Wa An-Na Muhammadan 'Abduka Wa Rasuluka. Salla Allahu 'Alayhi Wa Aalehee Wa 'Ala Dhuriyateheet Tayyibeenat Taaheereen Wa Salla-Ma Tasleeman Katheera.
segments.translation: and verily Muhammad is Your slave and Your Prophet, blessings of Allah be upon him and upon his family and upon his children, the righteous and pure, and send salutations (upon them), an appropriate salutation in multitude.

segments.transliteration: Allahumma Eeyaaka Arjuu Wa Eeyaaka Ad'oou Fa Bal-Ligh-Nee Amalee Wa Aslih 'Amalee.
segments.translation: O' Allah! Verily we turn to You and verily we call upon You, so help me to reach my hopes and desires and make my actions righteous.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَلْكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ وَ الْمُعَافَاةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
segments.transliteration: Allaahumma Innee As-Alukal A'fwa Wal A'afiyata Wal Mu-A'afaata Fid Dunyaa Wal Aakhirati
segments.translation: Oh God, I ask you for forgiveness, well-being, and well-being in this world and the hereafter.

segments.arabic: يَا مُخَلَّصَ الشَّجَرِ مِنْ بَيْنِ رَمْلٍ وَ طِينِ وَمَاءِ وَ يَا مُخَلِّصَ اللَّبَنِ مِنْ بَيْنِ فَرْثٍ وَ دَمٍ وَ يَا مُخَلَّصَ الْوَلَدِ مِنْ بَيْنِ مَشِيمَةٍ رَحِمٍ وَ يَا مُخَلِّصَ النَّارِ مِنْ بَيْنِ الْحَدِيدِ وَ الْحَجَرِ وَ يَا مُخَلِّصَ الرُّوحِ مِنْ بَيْنِ الْأَحْشَاءِ وَ الْأَمْعَاءِ خَلَصْنِي مِنْ يَدَى ......
segments.transliteration: Yaa Mukhallis'ash Shajari Min Bayni Ramlin Wa T'eenin Wa Maa-In Wa Yaa Mukhallis'al Labani Min Bayni Farthin Wa Damin Wa Yaa Mukhallis'al Waladi Min Bayni Masheematin Wa Rah'imin Wa Yaa Mukhallis'an Naari Min Baynil H'adeedi Wal H'ajari Wa Yaa Mukhallisar Rooh'i Min Baynil Ah'shaa-I Wal Am-A'a-I Khallis'nee Min Yadayo
segments.translation: O Savior of trees from between sand and clay and water, O Savior of milk from between dung and blood, O Savior of the child from between the placenta of a womb, and O Savior The fire is from between the iron and the stone, and O Savior of the soul, from between the entrails and the intestines, save me from my hand......

segments.arabic: يَا مُخَلِصَ اللَّبْنَ مِنْ بَيْنِ فَرْثٍ وَ دَمٍ نَجِّنِي مِنَ الْمَحْبَسِ بِحَقِّ عِبَادِكَ الْمُخْلِصِ
segments.transliteration: Ya mukhalis alllabn min bayn farth w dam najjini min almahbas bihaqq eibadik almukhlis
segments.translation: O the One who has purified the milk (that comes) from between the refuse and blood. Save me from the prison for the sake of your sincere servants.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِحَقِّ الْعَرْشِ وَ مَنْ عَلَاهُ،
segments.translation: O Allah, by the right of the Throne and its bearer,

segments.arabic: وَ بِحَقِّ الْوَحِي وَ مَنْ أَوْحَاهُ،
segments.transliteration: wa bihaqqi al-wahi wa man awhahu,
segments.translation: and by the right of the Revelation and its receiver,

segments.arabic: وَ بِحَقِّ النَّبِيِّ وَ مَنْ نَبَّاهُ،
segments.transliteration: wa bihaqqi al-nabiyyi wa man nabba'ahu,
segments.translation: and by the right of the Prophet and his teachings,

segments.arabic: وَ بِحَقِّ الْبَيْتِ وَ مَنْ بَنَاهُ.
segments.transliteration: wa bihaqqi al-bayti wa man banahu,
segments.translation: and by the right of the Sacred House and its builder.
O Hearer of every sound,
O Gatherer of all that is lost,
O Creator of souls after death,

segments.arabic: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ.
segments.translation: Send blessings upon Muhammad and his family.

segments.arabic: وَ آتِنَا وَ جَمِيعَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ،
segments.transliteration: Wa atina wa jami'a al-mu'minina wa al-mu'minat,
segments.translation: And grant us and all believing men and women,
across the East and the West of the earth,
relief from You, swiftly,

segments.arabic: بِشَهَادَةِ أَن لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ.
segments.transliteration: Bi shahadati an la ilaha illa Allah,
segments.translation: with the testimony that there is no god but Allah.
and that Muhammad is Your servant and messenger,
may Allah send blessings upon him and his family,
and upon his pure and righteous offspring,
and grant abundant peace and salutations.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِيَّاكَ أَرْجُو وَ إِيَّاكَ ادْعُو،
segments.transliteration: Allahumma iyaka arju wa iyaka ad'u,
segments.translation: O Allah, in You I hope and to You I pray,
so fulfill my aspirations and rectify my deeds.

segments.arabic: اَلَّهُمَّ صَلّ عَلىٰ فَاطِمَةَ وَ اَبِيْهَا وَ بَعْلِهَا وَ بَنِيْهَا وَ سِرِِّ الْمُسْتَوْدِعِ فِيْهَا بِعَدَدِ مَا اَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُكَ
segments.transliteration: ma Salle al Fatima wa abeeha wa baleha wa baneeha wa sirril mustaudaeh fiha beadada maa ahaata be
segments.translation: Oh Allah send blessings on Fatima and her father, her husband and her sons, and by the secret installed in her (S)) which only is in YOUR know

segments.arabic: اَللّٰہُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمٰوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِیْمِ.
segments.transliteration: allaahumma rabbas samaawaatis sab-eâ wa rabbal aârshil aâzeeme.
segments.translation: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and the Lord of the great Throne.

segments.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَ رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، مُنْزِلَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَ الْاِنْجِيْلِ وَ الْفُرْقَانِ، فَالِقَ الْحَبِّ وَ النَّوٰی، اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ كُلِّ شَیْءٍ اَنْتَ اٰخِذٌ بِنَاصِیَتِہٖ.
segments.transliteration: rabbanaa wa rabba kulle shayin, munzelat tawraate wal injeele wal furqaane, faaleqal habbe wan nawaa, a-oâozo beka min kulle shay-in anta aakhezun be-naaseyatehi.
segments.translation: O our Lord and the Lord of everything, revealer of the Taurat, Injeel and Furqan, splitter of the seed and grain. I seek your refuge from everything, whose control is in your hands.

segments.arabic: اَنْتَ الْاَوَّلُ فَلَيْسَ قَبْلَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَ اَنْتَ الْاٰخِرُ فَلَیْسَ بَعْدَكَ شَیْءٌ وَ اَنْتَ الظَّاہِرُ فَلَیْسَ فَوْقَكَ شَیْءٌ، وَ اَنْتَ الْبَاطِنُ فَلَیْسَ دُوْنَكَ شَیْءٌ اِقْضِ عَنِّی الدَّیْنَ، وَ اَغْنِنِیْ مِنَ الْفَقْرِ.
segments.transliteration: antal awwalo falaysa qablaka shay-un, wa antal aakhero fa-laysa baâdaka shay-un wa antaz zaahero fa-laysa fawqaka shay-un, wa antal baateno fa-laysa doonaka shay-un iqze aânneyad dayna, wa aghnenee menal faqre.
segments.translation: You are the first, there is nothing before You; and You are the last and there is nothing after You. You are the apparent and there is nothing above You; and You are the concealed and there is nothing nearer than You, facilitate the repayment of my debt and make me needless from poverty.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ بِحَقِّ الْعَرْشِ وَ مَنْ عَلَاهُ، وَ بِحَقِّ الْوَحْيِ وَ مَنْ اَوْحَاهُ، وَ بِحَقِّ النَّبِيِّ وَ مَنْ نَبَّاَهُ، وَ بِحَقِّ الْبَيْتِ وَ مَنْ بَنَاهُ، يَا سَامِعَ كُلِّ صَوْتٍ، يَا جَامِعَ كُلِّ فَوْتٍ، يَا بَارِءَ النُّفُوْسِ بَعْدَ الْمَوْتِ، صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اَهْلِ بَيْتِهٖ وَ اٰتِنَا وَ جَمِيْعَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ فِيْ مَشَارِقِ الْاَرْضِ وَ مَغَارِبِهَا فَرَجًا مِنْ عِنْدِكَ عَاجِلًا بِشَهَادَةِ اَنْ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللهُ، وَ اَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَ رَسُوْلُكَ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ اٰلِهٖ، وَ عَلٰى ذُرِّيَّتِهِ الطَّيِّبِيْنَ الطَّاهِرِيْنَ، وَ سَلَّمَ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْرًا.
segments.transliteration: allaahumma be-haqqil aârshe wa man aâlaaho, wa be-haqqil wahye wa man awhaaho, wa be-haqqin nabiyye wa man nabbaaho, wa be-haqqil bayte wa man nabaaho, yaa saame-aâ kulle sawtin, yaa jaame-aâ kulle fawtin, yaa baare-an nofoose baâdal mawte, salle aâlaa mohammadin wa ahle baytehi wa aatenaa wa jamee-aâl moameneena wal moamenaate fee mashaareqil arze wa maghaarebehaa farajan min iândeka aâajelan be-shahaadate an laa elaaha illal laaho, wa anna mohammadan aâbdoka wa rasooloka sallal laaho aâlayhe wa aalehi, wa aâlaa zurriyyatehit tayyebeenat taahereena, wa sallama tasleeman kaseeran.
segments.translation: O God, I adjure You by the right of the Arsh and the one, who raised it, and by the right of revelation and by one, who sent; and by the right of the Prophet and one, who made him a prophet; and by the right of Kaaba and one, who made it. O one, who listens to every voice. O one, who gathers all that are lost. O one, who revives the souls after death, bless Muhammad and his Ahle Bayt and grant from your side to me and the believer men and women of the east and the west of the world immediate tranquility and peace. I adjure by the right of âthere is no god, except Allah and Muhammad is the messenger of Allahâ. May Allah have mercy on Muhammad and his purified progeny and convey my salutation to them in excess.

segments.arabic: - اَللّٰهُمَّ وَ اَعْدَائِيْ وَ مَنْ كَادَنِيْ بِسُوءٍ اِنْ اَتَوْا بَرًّا فَجَبِّنْ شَجِيْعَهُمْ...
segments.transliteration: - allaahumma wa a-aâdaa-ee wa man kaadanee be-soo-in in ataw barran fa-jabbin sha-jee-aâhumâ¦
segments.translation: - O God, if my enemies and those, who deceive me, if they intend to cause distress, weaken the strength of their heartâ¦[1]

segments.arabic: - اَللّٰهُمَّ اكْفِنِيْ حَسَدَ الْحَاسِدِيْنَ، وَ بَغْيَ الْبَاغِيْنَ، وَ كَيْدَ الْكَافِرِيْنَ‏...
segments.transliteration: - allaahummak fenee hasadal haasedeena, wa baghyal baagheena, wa kaydal kaafereenaâ¦
segments.translation: - O Allah, suffice me against the envy of the envious and the tyranny of the tyrants and the machination of the disbelieversâ¦[2]

segments.arabic: - اَللّٰهُمَّ احْرُسْنَا بِعَيْنِكَ الَّتِيْ لَا تَنَامُ، وَ رُكْنِكَ الَّذِي لَا يُرَامُ...
segments.transliteration: - allaahummah rusnaa be-aâynekal latee laa tanaamo, wa ruknekal lazee laa yoraamoâ¦
segments.translation: - O God, protect us through the eyes that never sleep and through that support no one can reachâ¦[3]

segments.arabic: يَا عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَ السَّرَائِرِ، يَا مُطَاعُ يَا عَلِيْمُ، يَا اَللهُ يَا اَللهُ يَا اَللهُ يَا هَازِمَ الْاَحْزَابِ لِمُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ، يَا كَائِدَ فِرْعَوْنَ لِمُوْسٰى، يَا مُنْجِيَ عِيْسٰى مِنْ اَيْدِي الظَّلَمَةِ، يَا مُخَلِّصَ قَوْمِ نُوْحٍ مِنَ الْغَرَقِ، يَا رَاحِمَ عَبْدِهٖ يَعْقُوْبَ يَا كَاشِفَ ضُرِّ اَيُّوْبَ، يَا مُنْجِيَ ذِي النُّوْنِ مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ، يَا فَاعِلَ كُلِّ خَيْرٍ، يَا هَادِيًا اِلٰى كُلِّ خَيْرٍ، يَا دَالًّا عَلٰى كُلِّ خَيْرٍ، يَا اٰمِرًا بِكُلِّ خَيْرٍ، يَا خَالِقَ الْخَيْرِ، وَ يَا اَهْلَ الْخَيْرِ، اَنْتَ اللهُ رَغِبْتُ اِلَيْكَ فِيْمَا قَدْ عَلِمْتَ وَ اَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوْبِ، اَسْاَلُكَ اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ...
segments.transliteration: yaa aâalemal ghaybe was saraa-ere, yaa motaa-oâ yaa aâleemo, yaa allaaho yaa allaaho yaa allaaho yaa haazemal ahzaabe le-mohammadin sallal laaho aâlayhe wa aalehi, yaa kaa-eda fir-aâwna le-moosaa, yaa munjeya eâesaa min aydiz zalamate, yaa mokhallesa qawme noohin menal gharaqe, yaa raahema a'bdeâi yaâqooba yaa kaashefa zurre ayyooba, yaa munjeya zeen noone menaz zolomaate, yaa faa-eâla kulle khayrin, yaa haadeyan elaa kulle khayrin, yaa daal-lan aâlaa kulle khayrin, yaa aameran be-kulle khayrin, yaa khaaleqal khayre, wa yaa ahlal khayre, antal laaho ra-ghibto elayka feemaa qad aâlimta wa anta aâllaamul ghoyoobe, as-aloka an tosalleya aâlaa mohammadin wa aale mohammadinâ¦
segments.translation: O knower of the unseen and the secrets, O one, worthy of obedience and the most knowing, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, O one, who defeated all the parties for Muhammad (s.a.w.a.), O one, who took revenge of Musa from Firon. O one, who saved Isa from the oppressors. O One, who saved the people of Nuh from drowning. O one, who had mercy on His servant, Yaqub. O one, who dispelled the troubles of Ayyub. O one, who gave relief to Yunus from the darknesses. O the doer of every good. O the guide to every good. O one, who shows the way to every good. O, one who commands every good. O creator of every good. O owner of all the good. You are that Allah, towards whom I have turned in the issues that You know well. As You are the knower of all the unseen. I beseech You to send mercy on Muhammad and progeny of Muhammadâ¦

O you who are safe from everything and every thing is afraid of you, cautious, I ask you by your security from everything and the fear of everything from you, to send blessings upon Muhammad and To give me security for myself, my family, my money, and my children, so that I will not fear anyone or be wary of anything at all. You are powerful over all things.

segments.transliteration: Allahumma Salle ala Mohammed wa Aalehi
segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

segments.arabic: يا آمِناً مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْى ءٍ وَ كُلُّ شَيْى ءٍ مِنْكَ خآئِفٌ حَذِرٌ اَسْئَلُكَ بِاَمْنِكَ مِنْ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَ خَوْفِ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ مِنْكَ اَنْ تُصَلِّىَ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اَنْ تُعْطِيَنى اَماناً لِنَفْسى وَ اَهْلى وَ مالى وَ وَلَدى حَتّى لا اَخافَ اَحَداً وَ لا اَحْذَرَ مِنْ شَىْءٍ اَبَدَاً اِنَّكَ عَلى كُلِّ شَيْى ءٍ قَديرٌ
segments.transliteration: Be haqqe Fatima wa abeeha wa baleha wa baneeha wa sirril mustaudaeh fiha
segments.translation: Fatima and her father, her husband and her sons, and by the secret installed in her (sa)

segments.transliteration: An tusslle `ala Muhammadin wa ali Muhammad
segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

segments.arabic: بِ حَقِّ فَاطِمَةَ وَ اَبِيْهَا وَ بَعْلِهَا وَ بَنِيْهَا وَ سِرِِّ الْمُسْتَوْدِعِ فِيْهَا
segments.transliteration:
Wa an tafal be anta ahlo 
Wa la tafalbe ma Ana ahlo
segments.translation: Please act as per your stature and do not act based on what I deserve

segments.arabic: اَنْ تُصَلِّ علَىٰ مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد

وَ اَنْ تَفْعَل بِىْ اَنْتَ اَهْلُهُ
وَلاَ تَفْعَلْ بِىْ مَا اَنَا اَهْلُهُ

Arabic Transliteration Translation Ziyarat Another Ver Farewell Resources Comprehensive Iraq Ziarats | Comprehensive Karbala Ziarats 20th Safar- /Arbaeen (Chehlum - 40th day after Ashura ) ' Arbaeen ' witnesses the LARGEST peaceful gathering EVER on the earth. Millions visit Kerbala- Iraq , to commemorate the Martyrdom of Imam Hussain (as) the grandson of the Prophet of Islam, in yr 680 AD ! Walk of free - The Epic walk undertaken by millions to Kerbala Huffington post Article) According to Imam Hasan bin Ali Al Askari (as) The signs of a true believer are five:- 1) Recite 51 Rakâaât Salaat during the 24 hours of the day (17 Rakâaâts obligatory, + 34 Rakâaâts in Naafilah Salaats). 2) Be in Karbala for Ziyarat of Imam Husayn (as)/other martyrs, or at least recite Ziyarat of the Holy Imam as given below 3) To wear a ring in the right hand. 4) To put the forehead on the earth (preferably on the earth of Karbala) in prostration. 5) To pronounce âBismillahir-Rahâmaanir-Rahâeemâ in clear and loud voice while praying the salats. segments.translation: Peace be upon the intimate servant of Allah and His most-beloved.
Peace be upon the friend of Allah and His elite.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ صَفِيِّ ٱللَّهِ وَٱبْنِ صَفِيِّهِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon the choice of Allah and son of His choice.
Peace be upon al-Husayn the wronged and martyred.
Peace be upon the captive of agonies
and victim of the shed tears.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِِنِّي اشْهَدُ انَّهُ وَلِيُّكَ وَٱبْنُ وَلِيِّكَ
segments.transliteration: allahumma inniÂ ashhadu annahu waliyyuka wabnu waliyyika
segments.translation: O Allah, I do bear witness that he is verily Your intimate servant and son of Your intimate servant,
Your choice and son of Your choice,
and the winner of Your honoring.
You have honored him with martyrdom,
endued him with happiness,
privileged him with legitimate birth,
made him one of the chiefs,
one of the leaders,
and one of the defenders (of Your religion),
gave him the inheritances of the Prophets,

segments.arabic: وَجَعَلْتَهُ حُجَّةً عَلَىٰ خَلْقِكَ مِنَ ٱلاوْصِيَاءِ
segments.transliteration: wa ja`altahu hujjatan `alaÂ khalqika min al-awsiya'i
segments.translation: and chose him as argument against Your created beings and one of the Prophetsâ successors.
So, he called to you flawlessly,
gave advices,
and sacrificed his soul for You
to save Your servants from ignorance
and perplexity of straying off.

segments.arabic: وَقَدْ تَوَازَرَ عَلَيْهِ مَنْ غَرَّتْهُ ٱلدُّنْيَا
segments.transliteration: wa qad tawazara `alayhi man gharrat-hu alddunya
segments.translation: Yet, those whom were seduced by this worldly life,
who sold their share (of reward) with the lowliest and meanest,
retailed their Hereafter with the cheapest price,

segments.transliteration: wa taghatrasa wa taraddaÂ fi hawahu
segments.translation: acted haughtily, perished because of following their desires,
brought to themselves Your wrath and the wrath of Your Prophet,

segments.arabic: وَاطَاعَ مِنْ عِبَادِكَ اهْلَ ٱلشِّقَاقِ وَٱلنِّفَاقِ
segments.transliteration: wa ata`a min `ibadika ahla alshshiqaqi walnnifaqi
segments.translation: and obeyed the dissident and hypocritical servants of You
and the bearers of the burdens (of sins) who deserve Hellfireâall those supported each other against him.
However, he fought against them painstakingly with steadfastness expecting Your reward
until his blood was shed on account of his obedience to You
and his women were violated.
So, O Allah, pour heavy curses on them
and chastise them with painful chastisement.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O son of Allahâs Messenger.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ سَيِّدِ ٱلاوْصِيَاءِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O son of the chief of the Prophetsâ successors.

segments.arabic: اشْهَدُ انَّكَ امِينُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱبْنُ امِينِهِ
segments.transliteration: ashhadu annaka aminu allahi wabnu aminihi
segments.translation: I bear witness that you are verily the trustee of Allah and the son of His trustee.
You lived with happiness,
passed away with praiseworthiness,
and died missed, wronged, and martyred.

segments.arabic: وَاشْهَدُ انَّ ٱللَّهَ مُنْجِزٌ مَا وَعَدَكَ
segments.transliteration: wa ashhadu anna allaha munjizun maÂ wa`adaka
segments.translation: I also bear witness that Allah shall inevitably fulfill His promise to You,
exterminate those who disappointed you,
and chastise those who slew you.

segments.transliteration: wa ashhadu annaka wafayta bi`ahdi allahi
segments.translation: I also bear witness that you fulfilled your pledge to Allah

segments.arabic: وَجَاهَدْتَ فِي سَبِيلِهِ حَتَّىٰ اتَاكَ ٱلْيَقِينُ
segments.transliteration: wa jahadta fi sabilihi hattaÂ ataka alyaqinu
segments.translation: and strove hard in His way until death came upon you.
So, may Allah curse those who slew you.
May Allah curse those who wronged you.

segments.arabic: وَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ امَّةً سَمِعَتْ بِذٰلِكَ فَرَضِيَتْ بِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu ummatan sami`at bidhalika faradiyat bihi
segments.translation: May Allah curse the people who, when informed about that, were pleased with it.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِِنِّي اشْهِدُكَ انِّي وَلِيٌّ لِمَنْ وَالاَهُ
segments.transliteration: allahumma inni ushhiduka anni waliyyun liman walahu
segments.translation: O Allah, I do ask You to witness for me that I am loyalist to those who are loyalists to him
and enemy of those who are enemies of him.

segments.arabic: بِابِي انْتَ وَامِّي يَا بْنَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
segments.transliteration: bi'abi anta wa ummi yabna rasuli allahi
segments.translation: May my father and mother be accepted as ransoms for you, O son of Allahâs Messenger.

segments.arabic: اشْهَدُ انَّكَ كُنْتَ نُوراً فِي ٱلاصْلاَبِ ٱلشَّامِخَةِ
segments.transliteration: ashhadu annaka kunta nuran fi al-aslabi alshshamikhati
segments.translation: I bear witness that you were light in the sublime loins
and purified wombs;
the impurities of the Ignorance Era could not object you to filth

segments.transliteration: wa lam tulbiska almudlahimmatu min thiyabiha
segments.translation: nor could its murky clothes dress you.

segments.transliteration: wa ashhadu annaka min da`a'imi alddini
segments.translation: I also bear witness that you are one of the mainstays of the religion,
the supports of Muslims,
and the haven of the believers.

segments.transliteration: wa ashhadu annaka al-imamu albarru alttaqiyyu
segments.translation: I also bear witness that you are the God-fearing, pious,
pleased, immaculate,
guide, and well-guided Imam.

segments.arabic: وَاشْهَدُ انَّ ٱلائِمَّةَ مِنْ وُلْدِكَ كَلِمَةُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ
segments.transliteration: wa ashhadu anna al-a'immata min wuldika kalimatu alttaqwa
segments.translation: And I bear witness that the Imams from your progeny are the spokesmen of piety,
the signs of guidance,
the firmest handle (of Islam),
and the decisive Argument against the inhabitants of the world.

segments.transliteration: wa ashhadu anni bikum mu'minun wa bi'iyabikum
segments.translation: I also bear witness that I believe in you all and in your Return,
I have full confidence in the laws of my religion and in the seals of my deeds,
my heart is at peace with you all,
all my affairs are based on your commands,
and my support for you all is already all set
until Allah permits you.
So, I am with you. I am with you,
not with your enemies.
Allahâs blessings be upon you,
upon your souls, upon your bodies,
upon the present and the absent from you,
and upon the apparent and the invisible from you.
Respond to us, O Lord of the Worlds.

segments.transliteration: As-salÄmu Ê¿alÄ walÄ« AllÄh wa á¸¥abÄ«bihi,
segments.translation: Peace be upon the friend of Allah and His beloved,

segments.transliteration: As-salÄmu Ê¿alÄ khalÄ«l AllÄh wa najÄ«yihi,
segments.translation: Peace be upon the confidant of Allah and His intimate,

segments.arabic: السَّلامُ عَلَى وَ لِيِّ اللّهِ وَحَبِيبِهِ ،
segments.transliteration: As-salÄmu Ê¿alÄ á¹£afÄ« AllÄh wa ibn á¹£afÄ«yihi,
segments.translation: Peace be upon the chosen one of Allah and the son of His chosen one,
Peace be upon al-á¸¤usayn, the oppressed martyr,

segments.arabic: السَّلامُ عَلَى صَفِيِّ اللّهِ وَابْنِ صَفِيِّهِ ،
segments.transliteration: As-salÄmu Ê¿alÄ asÄ«r al-kurubÄt wa qatÄ«l al-Ê¿abarÄt,
segments.translation: Peace be upon the captive of sorrows and the slain of tears.

segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma innÄ« ashhadu annahu walÄ«yuka wa ibn walÄ«yika,
segments.translation: O Allah, I bear witness that he is Your friend and the son of Your friend,

segments.arabic: السَّلامُ عَلَى أَسِيرِ الْكُرُباتِ وَقَتِيلِ الْعَبَرَاتِ .
segments.translation: And Your chosen one and the son of Your chosen one,

segments.arabic: اللّهُمَّ إِنِّى أَشْهَدُ أَ نَّهُ وَ لِيُّكَ وَابْنُ وَ لِيِّكَ ،
segments.translation: The one who achieved Your honor,
You honored him with martyrdom,
And bestowed upon him happiness,
And selected him with a pure birth,
And made him a master among the masters,
And a leader among the leaders,
And a defender among the defenders,
And You gave him the inheritances of the prophets,

segments.transliteration: Wa jaÊ¿altahu á¸¥ujjatan Ê¿alÄ khalqik min al-awá¹£iyÄâ,
segments.translation: And made him a proof over Your creation from among the guardians,
So he excused himself in calling,

segments.arabic: وَجَعَلْتَهُ حُجَّةً عَلَى خَلْقِكَ مِنَ الْأَوْصِيَاءِ ،
segments.translation: And he granted advice,

segments.transliteration: Wa badhala muhjatahu fÄ«ka li-yastanqidh Ê¿ibÄdaka mina al-jahÄlah,
segments.translation: And he sacrificed his life for You to save Your servants from ignorance,
And the bewilderment of misguidance,

segments.arabic: وَبَذَلَ مُهْجَتَهُ فِيكَ لِيَسْتَنْقِذَ عِبَادَكَ مِنَ الْجَهَالَةِ ،
segments.transliteration: Wa qad tawÄzara Ê¿alayhi man gharrathu ad-dunyÄ,
segments.translation: And those who were deceived by the world rallied against him,
And sold his share for the lowest and meanest,

segments.arabic: وَقَدْ تَوَازَرَ عَلَيْهِ مَنْ غَرَّتْهُ الدُّنْيا ،
segments.translation: And exchanged his Hereafter for the cheapest price,

segments.transliteration: Wa taghaá¹­rasa wa taraddÄ fÄ« hawÄhu,
segments.translation: And he became arrogant and fell into his desires,
And angered You and angered Your Prophet,

segments.transliteration: Wa aá¹­ÄÊ¿a min Ê¿ibÄdika ahl ash-shiqÄq wa an-nifÄq,
segments.translation: And obeyed from among Your servants the people of division and hypocrisy,
And the bearers of burdens,

segments.arabic: وَأَطَاعَ مِنْ عِبادِكَ أَهْلَ الشِّقاقِ وَالنِّفاقِ ،
segments.translation: Those who deserve the fire,

segments.transliteration: Fa-jÄhadahum fÄ«ka á¹£Äbiran muá¸¥tasiban á¸¥attÄ sufiÊ¾a fÄ« á¹­ÄÊ¿atik damuhu,
segments.translation: So he fought them for Your sake, patient and seeking Your reward, until his blood was spilled in Your obedience,
And his sanctity was violated.

segments.arabic: فَجاهَدَهُمْ فِيكَ صابِراً مُحْتَسِباً حَتَّى سُفِكَ فِي طَاعَتِكَ دَمُهُ ،
segments.translation: O Allah, curse them with a severe curse,
And punish them with a painful punishment.

segments.transliteration: As-salÄmu Ê¿alayka yÄ ibn RasÅ«l AllÄh,
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O son of the Messenger of Allah,

segments.transliteration: As-salÄmu Ê¿alayka yÄ ibn sayyid al-awá¹£iyÄÊ¾,
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O son of the master of the guardians,

segments.transliteration: Ashhadu annaka amÄ«n AllÄh wa ibn amÄ«nih,
segments.translation: I bear witness that you are the trustee of Allah and the son of His trustee,
You lived happily,

segments.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَ نَّكَ أَمِينُ اللّهِ وَابْنُ أَمِينِهِ ،
segments.translation: And departed praiseworthy,
And died a martyr,
Oppressed and martyred,

segments.transliteration: Wa ashhadu anna AllÄha munjiz laka mÄ waÊ¿adak,
segments.translation: I bear witness that Allah will fulfill for you what He promised you,
And destroy those who abandoned you,

segments.arabic: وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ اللّهَ مُنْجِزٌ لَكَ مَا وَعَدَكَ ،
segments.translation: And punish those who killed you,

segments.transliteration: Wa ashhadu annaka wafayta bi-Ê¿ahd AllÄh,
segments.translation: I bear witness that you fulfilled the covenant with Allah,

segments.transliteration: Wa jÄhadta fÄ« sabÄ«l AllÄh á¸¥attÄ atÄka al-yaqÄ«n,
segments.translation: And fought in the way of Allah until certainty (death) came to you,

segments.arabic: وَأَشْهَدُ أَ نَّكَ وَفَيْتَ بِعَهْدِ اللّهِ ،
segments.translation: So may Allah curse those who killed you,

segments.arabic: وَجاهَدْتَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللّه حَتّى أَتَاكَ الْيَقِينُ ،
segments.translation: And may Allah curse those who wronged you,

segments.transliteration: Wa laÊ¿ana AllÄh ummatan samiÊ¿at bi-dhÄlika faradhiyat bihi,
segments.translation: And may Allah curse the nation that heard of that and was pleased with it.

segments.transliteration: As-salÄmu Ê¿alayka yÄ á¸¥ujjat AllÄh fÄ« ará¸ih wa shÄhidahu Ê¿alÄ khalqih,
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O proof of Allah on His earth and witness over His creation,

segments.transliteration: As-salÄmu Ê¿alayka yÄ mawlÄya wa ibn mawlÄya,
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O my master and son of my master,

segments.arabic: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ الشَّهِيدُ ،

segments.transliteration: Wa amarta bi-l-maÊ¿rÅ«f wa nahayta Ê¿an al-munkar,

segments.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ قَدْ أَقَمْتَ الصَّلاَةَ وَآتَيْتَ الزَّكَاةَ ،

segments.arabic: وَجَاهَدْتَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللّهِ حَتَّى أَتَاكَ الْيَقِينُ ،
segments.transliteration: Ataytuka yÄ mawlÄya zÄâiran wÄfidan rÄghiban muqirran laka bi-dh-dhunÅ«b,

segments.transliteration: HÄriban ilayka min al-khaá¹­ÄyÄ li-tashfaÊ¿a lÄ« Ê¿inda rabbik yÄ ibn RasÅ«l AllÄh,
segments.translation: Fleeing to you from my mistakes so that you intercede for me with your Lord, O son of the Messenger of Allah,

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka an tusalliya `ala muhammadin
segments.translation: O Allah, I beseech You to send blessings upon Muhammad
the Prophet of Your mercy and the Word of Your Light,

segments.transliteration: wa an tamla'a qalbi nura alyaqini
segments.translation: and to fill in my heart with the illumination of certitude,
my chest with the illumination of faith,
my intellect with the illumination of honest intentions,
my determination with the illumination of knowledge,
my strength with the illumination of work,
my tongue with the illumination of honesty,
my religion with the illumination of clear evidence from You,
my sight with the illumination of brightness,
my hearing with the illumination of wisdom,

segments.transliteration: wa mawaddati nura almuwalati limuhammadin wa alihi
segments.translation: and my faculty of love with the illumination of sincere loyalty to Muhammad and his Household,
peace be upon them,

segments.arabic: حَتَّىٰ أَلْقَاكَ وَقَدْ وَفَيْتُ بِعَهْدِكَ وَمِيثَاقِكَ
segments.transliteration: hatta alqaka wa qad wafaytu bi`ahdika wa mithaqika
segments.translation: so that I, when I meet You, will have fulfilled the pledge and covenant that I made with You
and then Your mercy will encompass me.
O Protector! O Worthy of all praise!
O Allah, bless Muhammad (al-Mahdi)
Your argument in Your land,
Your viceroy in Your countries,
the caller to Your course,
the establisher of Your justice,
the revolting by Your command,
the authority of the believers,
the ruiner of the unbelievers,
the remover of the murk,
the illuminator of the truth,
the speaker with wisdom and honesty,
the perfect Word of You in Your lands,
the vigilant and fearful,
the well-wishing saint,
the ark of salvation,
the sign of guidance,
the light of the peoplesâ sights,

segments.transliteration: wa khayri man taqammasa wa irtada
segments.translation: the best of all those who put clothes on their bodies,
and the unveiler of blindness,
who will fill the lands with justice and equity
as it would be filled up with wrong and unfairness.
You verily have power over all things.
O Allah, bless Your vicegerent
and the son of Your vicegerents the obedience to whom You have made incumbent upon us
and the observance of the right of whom You have made obligatory
and from whom You have removed filth
and whom You have purified with thorough purifying.
O Allah, give him victory and make him the supporter of Your religion
and through him, give victory to Your and his adherents,
followers, and backers.
Include us with them.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ أَعِذْهُ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ بَاغٍ وَطَاغٍ
segments.transliteration: allahumma a`idhhu min sharri kulli baghin wa taghin
segments.translation: O Allah, protect him against the evil of every transgressor and tyrant
and against the evils of all Your creatures.

segments.arabic: وَٱحْفَظْهُ مِنْ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ
segments.transliteration: wahfazhu min bayni yadayhi wa min khalfihi
segments.translation: Guard him from ahead of him, behind him,
his right side, and his left side.

segments.arabic: وَٱحْرُسْهُ وَٱمْنَعْهُ مِنْ أَنْ يوُصَلَ إِلَيْهِ بِسُوءٍ
segments.transliteration: wahrus-hu wamna`hu min an yusala ilayhi bisu'in
segments.translation: Watch him and defend him against anything that may cause evil to him.

segments.transliteration: wahfaz fihi rasulaka wa ala rasulika
segments.translation: Save through him Your Messenger and the family of Your Messenger.
Manifest justice through him.
Aid him with victory.
Help his backers.
Frustrate those who intend to disappoint him.
Terminate those who intend to eradicate him.
And, through him, terminate the tyrants of unbelief,
kill the disbelievers, the hypocrites,
and all atheists,

segments.arabic: حَيْثُ كَانُوٱ مِنْ مَشَارِقِ ٱلأَرْضِ وَمَغَارِبِهَا
segments.transliteration: haythu kanu min mashariqi al-ardi wa magharibiha
segments.translation: wherever they are; in the east or the west of the earth
on the lands or in the oceans,
and, through him, fill in the earth with justice,
manifest the religion of Your Prophet,

segments.transliteration: salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi wa sallama
segments.translation: blessings and peace of You be upon him and his Household,

segments.transliteration: waj`alni allahumma min ansarihi wa a`wanihi
segments.translation: make me, O Allah, of his supporters, helpers,
followers, and adherents;

segments.arabic: وَأَرِنِي فِي آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّلاَمُ مَا يَأْمُلُونَ
segments.transliteration: wa arini fi ali muhammadin `alayhim alssalamu ma ya'muluna
segments.translation: allow me to see the hopes of the family of Muhammad, peace be upon them, come true,
and the hazards of their enemies come true.
O God of Truth, respond.
O Lord of Glory and Honor!
O most merciful of those who show mercy!

segments.translation: My Lord, my sins have rendered me speechless, and my speech is cut short,

segments.arabic: فَلاَ حُجَّةَ لِي، فَأَنَا الأَسِيـرُ بِبَلِيَّتِي،
segments.transliteration: fa-lÄ á¸¥ujjata lÄ«, fa-ana l-asÄ«ru bi-baliyyatÄ«,
segments.translation: so I have no argument (or plea), for I am the captive of my affliction,
the one held in pledge by my deed, the one faltering in my mistake,
the bewildered one away from my purpose, the one cut off (with no way out),

segments.arabic: قَدْ أَوْقَفْتُ نَفْسِي مَوْقِفَ الأَذِلاَّءِ الْمُذْنِبِينَ،
segments.transliteration: Qad awqaftu nafsÄ« mawqifa l-adhillÄâi l-mudhnibÄ«n,
segments.translation: I have surely made myself stand in the station of the humiliated sinners,

segments.arabic: مَوْقِفَ الأَشْقِيآءِ الْمُتَجَرِّينَ عَلَيْكَ، الْمُسْتَخِفِّينَ بِوَعْدِكَ.
segments.transliteration: mawqiqa l-ashqiyÄâi l-mutajarrÄ«na âalayk, al-mustakhiffÄ«na bi-waâdik.
segments.translation: the station of the wretched ones who dared against You, those who took Your promise lightly.
Glory be to You! What daring did I dare against You?
And what deception did I deceive myself with?
My Master, have mercy on my fall (down) upon my noble face,

segments.arabic: وَزَلَّةَ قَدَمِي، وَعُدْ بِحِلْمِكَ عَلَى جَهْلِي،
segments.transliteration: wa-zallata qadamÄ«, wa-âud bi-á¸¥ilmika âalÄ jahlÄ«,
segments.translation: and the slip of my foot, and return with Your forbearance upon my ignorance,

segments.arabic: وَبِإحْسَانِكَ عَلَى إسَآءَتِي، فَأَنَا الْمُقِرُّ بِذَنْبِي،
segments.transliteration: wa-bi-iá¸¥sÄnik âalÄ isÄâatÄ«, fa-ana l-muqirru bi-dhanbÄ«,
segments.translation: and with Your benevolence upon my wrongdoing, for I am the one confessing my sin,
the one acknowledging my mistake, and here is my hand and my forelock,
I humble myself to be led by myself (to submit to punishment).
Have mercy on my gray hair, and the running out of my days,
and the nearness of my term (of death), and my weakness,
and my wretchedness, and the fewness of my resourcefulness.

segments.arabic: مَوْلاَيَ وَارْحَمْنِي إذَا انْقَطَعَ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا أَثَرِي،
segments.transliteration: MawlÄya wa-rá¸¥amnÄ« idhÄ nqaá¹­aâa mina d-dunyÄ atharÄ«,
segments.translation: My Master, and have mercy on me when my trace is cut off from the world,
and my mention is wiped away from the creatures,

segments.arabic: وَكُنْتُ فِي الْمَنْسِيِّينَ، كَمَنْ قَدْ نُسِيَ.
segments.transliteration: wa-kuntu fÄ« l-mansiyyÄ«n, ka-man qad nusÄ«.
segments.translation: and I am among the forgotten, like one who has been forgotten.
My Master, and have mercy on me when my form changes

segments.arabic: وَحَالِي إذَا بَلِيَ جِسْمِي، وَتَفَرَّقَتْ أَعْضَائِي،
segments.transliteration: wa-á¸¥ÄlÄ« idhÄ baliya jismÄ«, wa-tafarraqat aâá¸ÄâÄ«,
segments.translation: and my state, when my body wears out, and my limbs disperse,

segments.arabic: وَتَقَطَّعَتْ أَوْصَالِيْ، يا غَفْلَتِي عَمَّا يُرَادُ بِيَ.
segments.transliteration: wa-taqaá¹­á¹­aâat awá¹£ÄlÄ«, yÄ ghaflatÄ« âammÄ yurÄdu biya.
segments.translation: and my joints are severed. Oh, my heedlessness concerning what is intended for me!
My Master, and have mercy on me at my gathering and resurrection,

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَل فِي ذَلِكَ الْيَومِ مَعَ أَوْلِيَآئِكَ مَوْقِفِي،
segments.transliteration: wa-jâal fÄ« dhÄlika l-yawmi maâa awliyÄâika mawqifÄ«,
segments.translation: and make my station on that Day with Your friends,
and my proceeding (or return) with Your beloved ones,

segments.arabic: وَفِي جِوَارِكَ مَسْكَنِي يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ.
segments.transliteration: wa-fÄ« jiwÄrik maskanÄ« yÄ Rabba l-âÄlamÄ«n.
segments.translation: and my dwelling place in Your vicinity, O Lord of the Worlds.
1.My Lord, my sins have silenced me, and my words have been cut off.

segments.arabic: فَلاَ حُجَّةَ لِي، فَأَنَا الأَسِيـرُ بِبَلِيَّتِي،
segments.translation: 2.I have no argument, for I am the prisoner of my own affliction,
3.the hostage to my works, the frequenter of my own offense,
4.the confused in my intended way, the thwarted.

segments.arabic: قَدْ أَوْقَفْتُ نَفْسِي مَوْقِفَ الأَذِلاَّءِ الْمُذْنِبِينَ،
segments.translation: 5.I have brought myself to a halt in the halting place of the abased sinners,

segments.arabic: مَوْقِفَ الأَشْقِيآءِ الْمُتَجَرِّينَ عَلَيْكَ، الْمُسْتَخِفِّينَ بِوَعْدِكَ.
segments.translation: 6.the halting place of the wretched and insolent, those who think lightly of Your promise.
7.Glory be to You! What insolence I have insolently shown toward You!
8.What delusion with which I have deluded myself!
9.My Master, have mercy on my falling flat on my face

segments.arabic: وَزَلَّةَ قَدَمِي، وَعُدْ بِحِلْمِكَ عَلَى جَهْلِي،
segments.transliteration: wa zal-lata qadamee wa u'd bh'il-mika a'laa jah-lee
segments.translation: 10.the slipping of my foot, grant me my ignorance through Your clemency,

segments.arabic: وَبِإحْسَانِكَ عَلَى إسَآءَتِي، فَأَنَا الْمُقِرُّ بِذَنْبِي،
segments.transliteration: wa biih'-saanika a'laaa isaaa-atee faanaal-muqir-ru bid'ambee
segments.translation: 11.and my evildoing through Your beneficence, for I admit my sin

segments.transliteration: al-mua'-tarifu bikhat'ee-atee wa hd'ihee yadee wa naas'eeatee
segments.translation: 12.and I confess my offense: Here are my hand and my forelock!
13.I am resigned to retaliation against my soul!
14.Have mercy on my white hair, the depletion of my days,
15.the nearing of my term, my frailty,
16.my misery, and the paucity of my stratagems!

segments.arabic: مَوْلاَيَ وَارْحَمْنِي إذَا انْقَطَعَ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا أَثَرِي،
segments.transliteration: maw-laaya war-h'am-neee id'aa anqat'aa' minad-dunyaaa atharee
segments.translation: 17.My Master, and have mercy upon me when my trace is cut off from this world,
18.my mention is effaced among the creatures,

segments.arabic: وَكُنْتُ فِي الْمَنْسِيِّينَ، كَمَنْ قَدْ نُسِيَ.
segments.transliteration: wa kuntu fil-mansee-yeena kaman qad nusee
segments.translation: 19.and I join the forgotten, like the forgotten ones!
20.My Master, and have mercy upon me at the change of my form and state

segments.arabic: وَحَالِي إذَا بَلِيَ جِسْمِي، وَتَفَرَّقَتْ أَعْضَائِي،
segments.transliteration: wa h'aalee id'aa baleea jis-mee wa tafar-raqat aa'-z''aaa-ee
segments.translation: 21.when my body decays, my limbs are scattered,

segments.arabic: وَتَقَطَّعَتْ أَوْصَالِيْ، يا غَفْلَتِي  عَمَّا يُرَادُ بِيَ.
segments.transliteration: wa taqat'-t'aa't aw-s'aalee yaa ghaf-latee a'm-maa yuraadu bee
segments.translation: 22.and my joints are dismembered! O my heedlessness toward what was wanted from me!

segments.transliteration: maw-laaya war-h'amnee fee h'ash-ree wa nash-ree
segments.translation: 23.My Master, have mercy upon me at my mustering and uprising

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَل فِي ذَلِكَ الْيَومِ مَعَ أَوْلِيَآئِكَ مَوْقِفِي،
segments.transliteration: waj-a'l fee d'alikal-yawmi maa' aw-leeaaa-ika maw-qifee
segments.translation: 24.and on that day, appoint my standing place with Your friends,
25.my place of emergence with Your beloveds,

segments.arabic: وَفِي جِوَارِكَ مَسْكَنِي يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ.
segments.transliteration: wa fee jiwaarika mas-kanee yaa rab-bal-a'alameen
segments.translation: 26.and my dwelling in Your neighbourhood! O Lord of the worlds!

segments.arabic:
اَللّٰهُمَّ اَخْرِجْنِيْ مِنْ ظُلُمَاتِ 
الْوَهْمِ وَ اَكْرِمْنِيْ بِنُوْرِ الْفَهْمِ
segments.transliteration: Allhumma Akhrijni min zulumatil wahmi ,wa akrimni be nuril fahmi .
segments.translation: O GOD, please bring me out of the darkness of doubt and favour me with the light of comprehension,

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ افْتَحْ عَلَيْنَا اَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ وَ انْشُرْ عَلَيْنَا خَزَآئِنَ عُلُوْمِكَ
segments.transliteration: Allahumma afta alayna abwaba rahmateka, wa anshur alyna khazaena uloomeka
segments.translation: O GOD open to us the doors of your mercy and unfold for us the treasure of your knowledge by your mercy
O the most merciful of the merciful ones.

segments.arabic: للَّهُمَّ انْفَعْنِي بِمَا عَلَّمْـتَنِي وَ عَلِّمْنِي مَا يَنْفَعُنِي
segments.transliteration: âAllahumma infa'nii bimaa 'allamtanii wa'allimnii maa yanfa'uunii.
segments.translation: Oh Allah! Make useful for me what you have taught me and teach me knowledge that will be useful to me.

segments.arabic: .اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ فَهْمَ النَّبِيِّينَ وَ حِفْظَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ
segments.transliteration: Allahumma inii as'aluka fahmal-nabiyyen wa hifzal mursaleen al-muqarrabeen.
segments.translation: Oh Allah! I ask you for the understanding of the prophets and the memory of the messengers, and those nearest to you.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لِسَانِي عَامِرًا بِذِكْرِكَ وَ قَلْبِي بِخَشْيَتِك.
segments.transliteration: .Allahumma ijal leesanee 'aiman bi dhikrika wa qalbi bi khashyatika.
segments.translation: Oh Allah! Make my tongue full of your remembrance and my heart with awe of you.

segments.arabic: َ.إِنَّكَ عَلَى مَا تَشَاءُ قَدِيرٌ وَ أَنْتَ حَسْـبُنَا اللَّهُ وَ نِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
segments.transliteration: Innaka 'ala ma-tasha'u qadeer wa anta hasbun-allahu wa na'mal wakeel.'
segments.translation: Oh Allah! You do whatever you wish, and you are my availer and protector and best of aid.

segments.arabic: َللَّهُمَّ اَكْرِمْنْيْ بِنُوْرِ الْفَهْمِ وَ خَرَّجَنِيْ مِنْ ظُلُمَاتِ الْوَهْمِ
segments.transliteration: Allaahumma akrimnee binooril fahmi wa kharrajanee min z'ulumaatil wahmi
segments.translation: O Allah, honor me by the light of understanding and take me out from the darknesses of doubt
and open upon us the doors of Your knowledge

segments.arabic: وَ انْشُرْ عَلَيْنَا خُزَّانَ مَعْرِفَتِكَ يَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ،
segments.transliteration: Wan shur a'lainaa khuzzaanu ma'rifatika yaa arh'amar raah'imeen.
segments.translation:
and open upon us the treasure of Your recognition,
 O the best of the Merciful ones.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ وَفِّقْنِيْ فِىْ الْمُطَالَعَةِ بِحَلِّ جَمِيْعِ مُشْكِلاَتِ الْمَسَآئِلِ مِنَ الْكُتُبِ بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ.
segments.transliteration: Allaahumma waffiqnee fil mut'aala'ti bih'ablee jamee-i' mushkilaatil masaa-ili minal kutubi birah'matika yaa arh'amar raah'imeen
segments.translation: .O Allah, and give me Tawfeeq to the study and solving all the difficult problems through books. By Your mercy, O the best of the merciful ones

segments.arabic: للَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَ الْحَزَنِ  وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ العَجْزِ وَ الْكَسَلِ
segments.transliteration: Allhumma inni adhu bika min al-hammi wa al-hazan. Wa adhu bika min al-ajzi wa al-kasal.
segments.translation: Oh Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief,from helplessness and laziness,

segments.arabic: وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَ الْبُخْلِ وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ و قَهْرِ الرجال
segments.transliteration: Wa adhu bika min al-jubni wa al-bukhl. Wa adhu bika min ghalabat id-dayni wa qahr ir-rijal.
segments.translation: from cowardice and stinginess,and from overpowering of debt and from oppression of men

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لِيْ فِيْ قَلْبِيْ نُوْرًا وَ بَصَرًا وَ فَهْمًا وَ عِلْمًا اِنَّكَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْر
segments.transliteration: âAllahumma inni astaodeeka ma qaraâtu wama hafaz-tu.
segments.translation: O Allah let my heart be filled with light & insight & understanding & knowledge ,verily You control everything.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَوْدِعُكَ مَا قَرأتُ وَمَا حَفَظْتُ،
segments.translation: Oh Allah! I entrust you with what I have read and I have studied.

segments.transliteration: Innaka âala ma-tashaâ-u qadeer wa anta hasbeeya wa naâmal wakeelâ
segments.translation: Oh Allah! Bring it back to me when I am in need of it.

segments.arabic: إِنّكَ عَلى مَا تَشَاءُ قَدِيرُ وَأَنْتَ حَسْبِي وَنِعْمَ الوَكِيل
segments.transliteration: Allhumma l sahla ill m jaaltahu sahl wa anta tajalu al-hazana idh shita sahl.
segments.translation: Oh Allah! You do whatever you wish, you are my availer and protector and the best of aid

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لاَ سَهْلاً إِلّاَ مَا جَعَلّتَهٌ سَهْلاً وَأَنّتَ تَجّعَلَ الحَزَنَ إِذَا شِئتَ سَهْلاً
segments.transliteration: salla-l-laahu alaa muhammad wa aal-e muhammad. allahumma inni asaluka yaa mudhakkira-l khayr wa faailahu wa-l-aamira bihi dhakir-ni maa ansaani-hi-shaytan.
segments.translation: Oh Allah! Nothing is easy except what You have made easy. If You wish, You can make the difficult easy.

segments.arabic: صَلّىَ اللهُ عَلى مُحَمّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمّد. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْألُكَ يَا مُذَكِرَ الخَيْرِ وَفَاعِلَهُ  وَالآمِرَ بِهِ ذَكِرّنِي مَا اَنّسَانِهِ الشّيطَان
segments.transliteration: âYa sayyedas-sada-te, ya mojeebad-daâvate, ya rafeâad-darajate, ya vali-yal hasanate, ya ghaferal-khatiâate, ya moâti-yal masâalate, ya qabi-lat-tavbate, ya sameâal-asvate, ya âalemal-khafiyate, ya dafeâal bali yate.â
segments.translation: Blessings of God be upon Muhammad and his progeny. O God, I ask you, the one who mentions goodness and actualizes it and commands it, remind me of that which the shaytan makes me forget.

segments.arabic: يَا سَيِّدَ السَّادَاتِ يَا مُجِيبَ الدَّعَوَاتِ يَا رَافِعَ الدَّرَجَاتِ يَا وَلِيَّ الْحَسَنَاتِ يَا غَافِرَ الْخَطِيئَاتِ يَا مُعْطِيَ الْمَسْأَلاتِ يَا قَابِلَ التَّوْبَاتِ يَا سَامِعَ الأَصْوَاتِ يَا عَالِمَ الْخَفِيَّاتِ يَا دَافِعَ الْبَلِيَّاتِ
segments.translation: Oh the chief of all chiefs! Oh the acceptor of prayers! Oh the elevator of ranks! Oh the master of virtues! Ohthe forgiver of sins! Oh the granter of requests! Oh the excerptor of penance! Oh the hearer of all voices! Oh the one who knows all mysteries! Oh the remover of calamities!

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا اُمَّ الْاَئِمَّةِ الطَّاهِرِيْنَ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا اُمَّ المُؤْمِنِيْنَ
segments.transliteration: Assalaamo AâLayke Yaa Ummal A-Immatit Taahereena - Assalaamo AâLayke Yaa Ummal Momineena
segments.translation: Peace on you, O the mother of the pure Imams, Peace be on you, O the mother of the believing men
Peace be on you, O the first of the believing women
Peace be on you, O the sincere lady among the devoted ones

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا سَيِّدَةَ الْحَرَمِ وَ مَلِكَةَ الْبَطْحَاءِ
segments.transliteration: Assalaamo AâLayke Yaa Sayyedatal Harame Wa Malekatal Bathaa-E
segments.translation: Peace be on you, O the chief lady of the sacrosanct (haram) And the queen of Mecca

segments.arabic: السَّلاَم عَلَيْكِ يَا اَوَّلَ مَنْ صَدَّقَتْ ِرَسُوْلِ اللهِ مِنَ النِّسَآءِ
segments.transliteration: Assalaamo AâLayke Yaa Awwala Man Saddaqat Be Rasoolillaahe Menan Nesaaa-E
segments.translation: Peace be on you, O the first one to believe in the Apostle of Allah from among the women

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا مَنْ وَفَتْ بِالْعُبُوْدِيَّةِ حَقَّ الْوَفَاءِ وَ اَسْلَمَتْ نَفْسَهَا وَ اَنْفَقَتْ مَالَهَا لِسَيِّدِ الْاَنْبِيَآءِ
segments.transliteration: Assalaamo AâLayke Yaa Man Wafat Bil OâBoodiyyate Haqqal Wafaa-E Wa Aslamat Nafsahaa Wa Anfaqat Maalahaa Le Sayyedil Anbeyaaa-E
segments.translation: Peace be on you, O the one who observed servitude as it ought to be observed, submitted herself and discharged her wealth in the service of the chief of the Prophets.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا قَرِيْنَةَ حَبِيْبِ اِلٰهِ السَّمَآءِ الْمُزَّوَّجَةِ بِخُلاَصَةِ الْاَصْفِيَآءِ يَابْنَةَ اِبْرَاهِيْمَ الْخَلِيْلِ
segments.transliteration: Assalaamo AâLayke Yaa Qareenata Habeebe Elaahis Samaaail Mozawwajate Be Kholaasatil Asfeyaaa-E  Yabnata Ibraahemal Khaleele
segments.translation: Peace be on you, O the companion of the beloved of the Lord of the Heaven. The spouse of the epitome of the chosen ones. O the daughter of Ibraheem, the friend (of Allah)

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا مَنْ سَلَّمَ عَلَيْهَا جَبْرَئِيْلُ وَ بَلَّغَ اِلَيْهَا
segments.transliteration: Assalaamo AâLayke Yaa Man Sallama AâLayhaa Jibraeelo Wa Ballagha Elayhas
segments.translation: Peace be on you, O the one to whom Jibraeel used to salute and used to convey to her
the salutations from Allah, the Majestic.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا حَافِظَةَ دِيْنِ اللهِ
segments.translation: Peace be on you, O the protector of the religion of Allah.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا نَاصِرَةَ رَسُوْلِ اللهِ
segments.translation: Peace be on you, O the helper of the Apostle of Allah.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا مَنْ تَوَلىَّ دَفْنَهَا رَسُوْلُ اللهِ
segments.transliteration: Assalaamo AâLayke Yaa Man Tawallaa Dafnahaa Rasoolilaahe
segments.translation: Peace be on you, O the one whose burial was arranged by the Apostle of Allah
and he entrusted her to the Mercy of Allah.

segments.arabic: اَشْهَدُ اَنَّكِ حَبِيْبَةُ اللهِ وَ خِيَرَةَ اُمَّتِهِ وَ اَنَّ اللهَ
segments.transliteration: Ash-Hado Annake Habeebullaahe Wa Kheyarata Ummatehi Wa Annallaaha
segments.translation: I bear witness that you are esteemed near Allah

segments.arabic: جَعَلَكِ فِىْ مُسْتَقَرِّ رَحْمَتِهِ فِىْ قَصْرٍ مِّنَ الْيَاقُوْتِ
segments.translation: and the chosen one among His nation and that Allah has placed you in His Mercy

segments.arabic: وَ الْعِقْيَانِ فِىْ اَعْلٰى مَنَازِلِ الْجِنَانِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْكِ وَ رَحْمَةُ الله وَ بَرَكَاتُهُ
segments.transliteration: Fee Qasrin Menal Yaaqoote Wal EâQyaane Fee A-AâLaa Manaazelil Jenaane, Sallallaaho AâLayke Wa Rahmatullaahe Wa Barakaatohu
segments.translation: in a place built of ruby and in the highest grades of Paradise, May Allah send salutations upon you and His Mercy and Blessings .

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّٰهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ اَسْتَغِيْثُ فَاَغِثْنِى وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلٰى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ وَأَصْلِحْ لِى شَاْنِى كُلَّه
segments.transliteration:
Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyoomu birahmatika astagheetho, fa-aghithni 
wa laa Takilni ila nafsee Tarfata Aynin abadan, wa as-lih Lee Shani kullahu
segments.translation: In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. O Ever-Living, O Self-Sustaining, by Your mercy I seek help, so help me and do not leave me to myself for the blink of an eye, and set right all my affairs.

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّٰهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يَا اللهُ يَا حَافِظُ يَا حَفِيظُ يَا رَقِيبُ
segments.transliteration: Ya Allaho Ya Haafizo Ya Hafizo Ya Raqeebo
segments.translation: In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. O God, O Preserver, O Guardian, O Watcher.

O Most Merciful of the merciful.
1.O He the wonders of whose mightiness will never end!

5.Bless Muhammad and his Household
6.and release our necks from Your vengeance!

12.and bring us close to Your nearness!

17.Bless Muhammad and his Household
18.and expose us not before You!

segments.translation: 19.O God, remove our need for the gifts of the givers through Your gift,
20.spare us the loneliness of those who break off through Your joining,

segments.translation: 22.that we may feel lonely at no one's absence along with Your bounty!
23.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.translation: 24.scheme for us, not against us,

27.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

31.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household
32.and spare us the cutting edge of time's turning changes,

34.O God, the spared are spared only through the bounty

segments.translation: 35.of Your strength, so bless Muhammad and his Household, and spare us!

segments.translation: 37.so bless Muhammad and his Household and give to us!

39.so bless Muhammad and his Household and guide us!

segments.translation: 43.So bless Muhammad and his Household, defend us from Your servants
44.through Your might, free us from need for other than You through Your support,
45.and make us travel the path of the Truth through Your right guidance!

segments.translation: 47.into the remembrance of Your mightiness, the idleness of our bodies into giving thanks for Your favour,
48.and the flow of our tongues into the description of Your kindness!
49.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household
50.and make us one of Your summoners who summon to You,
51.Your guiders who direct to You,
52.and Your special friends whom You hast singled out!
53.O Most Merciful of the merciful!
